description: This file implements auto-responder functionality within the Mattermost server, including checking if a user has responded today, sending auto-responses, and managing auto-responder status.

classes.name: App
classes.description: Main application class providing methods for auto-responder functionality.

methods.name: checkIfRespondedToday
methods.description: Checks if the user has posted an auto-response in the channel today.

methods.name: SendAutoResponseIfNecessary
methods.description: Determines if an auto-response should be sent based on the channel, sender, and post.

methods.name: SendAutoResponse
methods.description: Sends an auto-response message if the receiver has auto-responder enabled.

methods.name: SetAutoResponderStatus
methods.description: Updates user status based on auto-responder activation or deactivation.

methods.name: DisableAutoResponder
methods.description: Disables the auto-responder for a user.
